frontier.hypothesis: A DImode (long long) intermediate that GCC folds or deletes before emission leaves an unallocated DImode pseudo, giving class-B-style 8-byte phantoms WITHOUT an emitted mult/div - the only untested route to four phantoms on a mult-free stream.
frontier.mechanism: s8's census shows the only bodies above three phantoms are func_80042874/func_80042A88 at six, both mult/div, whose phantoms are DImode HILO residue. s8 also showed a constant power-of-two divide folds at expand and leaves nothing. A long long expression whose high word is provably dead may still create the DImode pseudo at expand while emitting only SImode instructions.
frontier.next_probe: Read the .greg/.combine provenance of func_80042874's six phantoms (dump src/text1a_c.c with tools/gcc-2.7.2/cc1 -da) to see whether the DImode pseudo requires an emitted mult/div or merely a DImode expand; then spell a byte-neutral long long intermediate on func_800480C0's word/scale sites and measure with tmp/grind/func_800480C0/s6/probe.sh.

frontier.hypothesis: Both phantom producer classes are now measured closed on this body (class A on a cited predicate this session, class B at 1 across 41 forms in s2-s8), so the 32-byte untouched region has no remaining honest producer and the shape-invariance across the four siblings is a source DECLARATION.
frontier.mechanism: s8's frame census: all four siblings reserve the identical 0x18-0x37 window with args=0x18 and callee-saved base 0x38 despite 2/4/6/2 parameters; phantom residue tracks expression shape and would vary. Three of the four already carry owner-granted `volatile u32 pre_pad[8];` rows at engine/volatile_cheats.py:757-767.
frontier.next_probe: If the DImode route above also measures dead, the honest-producer search is complete and the correct disposition is an escalation-modality entry recording that both producer classes are closed with predicate cites, with the pre_pad row for func_800480C0 named as the re-activation trigger. Do NOT re-spell class A or class B.

frontier.hypothesis: One of the shipped sll/sra pairs sign-extends a value that DOES have a memory home - the two stack-passed s16 arguments arrive via `lw $v1,0x68($sp)` / `lw $a0,0x6C($sp)` - so the class-A substitution might fire there without touching the four halfword loads.
frontier.mechanism: H-s9-3's predicate closes the four halfword sites (base register set between load and use). The prologue's four sll/sra pairs on the s16 params are a separate population; arg2/arg3 arrive in registers with no memory home, but arg4/arg5 are incoming stack arguments whose slots are never written, so use_crosses_set_p has nothing to trip on for them.
frontier.next_probe: Check whether the two stack-passed s16 arguments can be spelled so combine substitutes their incoming stack MEM and folds `lw + sll + sra` into `lh 0x6A($sp)` - and, separately, whether any spelling keeps the emitted lw+sll+sra triple while still deleting an intermediate. Measure with s6/probe.sh; asm/funcs/func_800480C0.s lines 31-34 are the reference.

judge_constraints: func_800480C0 may not carry an unwritten volatile frame pad in any spelling until an owner ruling adds its row to engine/volatile_cheats.py::_SANCTIONED_UNWRITTEN_PADS; pursue an honest producer for the sp+0x18..0x37 untouched region instead.
